label: Break-ins in one residential development, Lower Moreland Township, PA, 2023

linking_evidence: all incidents occurred in the same development
similar entry method each time: kicking in a rear glass door or forcing open doors

after the suspect was arrested with another man for loitering and prowling in Bucks County in November 2023, police connected him to these incidents based on his appearance and clothing; the source of the images is not stated
ground_truth.notes: The only source is a local news site, not a police release. It says at least five burglaries but lists six dates. Series-level loss was reported as around 1 million dollars in items. Per-incident items, times, vehicle and recovered property are not reported.

outcome.summary: Arrest and charges announced by 2025-01-24: numerous felony counts of burglary, theft and receiving stolen property. Preliminary hearing pending at that date. Later outcome not reported.

data_policy: Public sources only. No suspect or victim names, ages, or exact addresses.
